propertySets.name: Pset_RailwaySignalAspect
propertySets.definition: Properties in this property set are applicable for IfcSignal and IfcSign applied in railways. These properties describe the signal aspect, which is the information on the signal or sign shown to the train driver.

properties.name: SignalAspectSymbol
properties.definition: Content which is shown on the signal or sign, e.g. text, number, arrow or icon.

properties.name: AppliesToTrainCategory
properties.definition: Sign information relative to train category, e.g. freight, passenger.

properties.name: SignalAspectType
properties.definition: The type of aspect, e.g. 2-display aspect for distant signal, 3-display aspect for block signal.

properties.name: SignLegend
properties.definition: Text information written on the signal or sign.

propertySets.name: Pset_RailwaySignalType
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of occurrences and types of IfcSignal applied in railways.

properties.name: SignalIndicatorType
properties.definition: Type of the indicators on a signal, e.g. route indicator, speed restriction indicator etc.

properties.name: LensDiffuserType
properties.definition: Type of the lens diffuser the signal is equipped with.

properties.name: HasConductorRailGuardBoard
properties.definition: Indicates if a guard board is provided.

properties.name: MaximumDisplayDistance
properties.definition: The maximum distance that can be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.

properties.name: RequiredDisplayDistance
properties.definition: The required distance that has to be displayed. The value relates only to the signal type, not to the circumstances at a special position.

properties.name: IsHighType
properties.definition: Indicates if the signal is high (TRUE) or dwarf (ground mounted) (FALSE).

properties.name: SignalHoodLength
properties.definition: Nominal length of the signal hood, which is the signal lamp cover against glaring sun.

properties.name: HotStripOrientation
properties.definition: Position of the hot strip, which indicates the direction of the focus of the light beam and is given in terms like "left upper quadrant (LUQ)" or "5 o'clock".

properties.name: LensDiffuserOrientation
properties.definition: Orientation the lens diffuser has to have, which indicates the direction of the lens diffuser and is given in terms like "left upper quadrant (LUQ)" or "5 o'clock".

properties.name: NumberOfLamps
properties.definition: Number of lamps the signal is composed of.

properties.name: SignalMessage
properties.definition: All possible message available at this signal, e.g. "3/4- display automatic blocking".

properties.name: RailwaySignalType
properties.definition: The type of railway signal, e.g. home signal, starting signal, shunting signal, level crossing signal.

propertySets.name: Pset_SignalFrame
propertySets.definition: Properties that define signal frame parameters for occurrences and types of IfcSignal applied in railways.

properties.name: BackboardType
properties.definition: The type of the backboard of the signal frame.

properties.name: SignalFrameType
properties.definition: Type of frame, e.g. main frame, route indicator, speed indicator, direction indicator, etc.

properties.name: NominalWidth
properties.definition: The nominal overall width of the object. The size information is provided in addition to the shape representation and the geometric parameters used within. In cases of inconsistency between the geometric parameters and the size properties, provided in the attached property set, the geometric parameters take precedence.

properties.name: SignalIndicatorType
properties.definition: Type of the indicators on a signal, e.g. route indicator, speed restriction indicator etc.

properties.name: SignalFrameBackboardHeight
properties.definition: The nominal height of the signal frame backboard.

properties.name: SignalFrameBackboardDiameter
properties.definition: The nominal diameter of the signal frame backboard.
